paite: Aw, TOUPA phat in la thak sa unla; leitung luah tengteng aw, TOUPA phat in la sa un.
heading: Pathian, Kumpipa Tungnungpen / (1 Kro 16.23-33)

paite: TOUPA phat a la sa in, amin phat unla; niteng in ahotdamna thu theisak un.
Namte lak ah athupina gen unla, michih kua peuhmah kiang ah athillamdang hihte gen un.
TOUPA a thupi a, nakpitak a phat ding ahi ngal a; Pathian tengteng sang a kihtak ding ahi.
Mipite pathiante milim ahi ua; TOUPA'N bel vante abawl ahi.
Pahtawina leh thupina ama ah a-om ua, hatna leh kilawmna amun siangthou ah a-om uhi.
Michih a chichihte aw, TOUPA kiang ah pia unla, TOUPA kiang ah thupina leh hatna pia un.
TOUPA kiang ah amin thupina pia unla, thillat ding tawi in ahuangsung intual ah hong pai un.
Aw, siangthou kilawmna silh in TOUPA bia unla; leitung luahte teng aw, ama ah ling un.
Namte lak ah, kumpipa in TOUPA atu, chi un! Leitung mah leng alin theihlouhna ding in, hihkip in a-om hi; ama'n khentuam nei lou in michih vai ahawm ding hi.
Vante kipaktak in om henla, lei leng nuamtak in om hen; tuipi leh asung a thil om tengteng lum honhon uhen;
Lou leh asung a om tengteng kipaktak in om henla; huai hun in gam a sing teng in nuam in la asa ding uh;
TOUPA ma ah, amah ahong pai dek hi; lei vaihawm ding in ahong dek ngal a. Khovel diktak in vai ahawmsak ding a, michih thutak in vai ahawmsak ding hi.
